description: Invented evaluation cases. Do not import these into the writing profile or evidence extraction. Compare personalized and generic drafts using identical new facts, then judge them yourself.

cases.title: SYNTHETIC: an English colleague follow-up
cases.context: Morgan: I took a look at the new signup flow. I got stuck halfway through.
cases.intent: Thank Morgan for trying it. Ask which step caused the problem and what they expected to happen. Explain that this helps me work out what to change.
cases.humanReference: Thanks for trying it, Morgan. Which step did you get stuck on, and what were you expecting to happen? That would help me figure out what needs changing.
judgmentQuestions: Which version sounds more like something you would send?
Does either version omit an intended point?
Did either version borrow facts from old examples?
Which exact wording would you change?

cases.title: SYNTHETIC: a German external contact
cases.context: Guten Tag, vielen Dank für Ihr Interesse. Wir könnten die Einführung als Online-Termin durchführen. Wäre das für Sie passend?
cases.intent: Für den Vorschlag bedanken. Ein Online-Termin passt grundsätzlich. Fragen, wie lange die Einführung dauert und ob es vorher Unterlagen zum Lesen gibt. Noch keinen konkreten Termin zusagen.
cases.humanReference: Guten Tag, vielen Dank für den Vorschlag. Ein Online-Termin passt für mich grundsätzlich gut. Wie viel Zeit sollten wir für die Einführung einplanen, und gibt es Unterlagen, die ich mir vorher ansehen kann? Beste Grüße
judgmentQuestions: Sind Wärme und wichtige Details erhalten?

cases.title: SYNTHETIC: cold outreach with sparse style evidence
cases.intent: Introduce myself as someone researching how small design teams collect customer feedback. Ask if the recipient would be open to sharing their approach. I do not know their current process or available times.
requiredContent: ask whether open to sharing approach
judgmentQuestions: Is the lack of outreach-specific evidence clear?
Is the invitation concrete without inventing familiarity?
What examples would help define this mode?
